_comment: Areas of the slice, from docs/design/world-and-map.md. Hull Cathedral (hub) enemies match the lowest level of the newest unlocked area; its elites are +2. Entry needs are informational: rooms enforce them through gates.

beam_bat.name: Beam Bat
beam_bat.text: Smashes crate bulkheads. Also hits things.

mitt_cannon.name: Mitt Cannon
mitt_cannon.text: Hold Sub-weapon to charge. A full charge triggers mitt targets.

spaceball.name: Spaceball
spaceball.text: Double-tap Down to morph. Fits 2-tile tunnels.

wall_kick.name: Wall Kick
wall_kick.text: Jump off walls. Chains between facing walls.
